rationale.conceptual: Standard DFT method (GGA-PBE) applied to well-known alkali halides; the only variation is a Rb-doped supercell, which is a minor modification. No novel algorithms or deep domain expertise required.
rationale.execution: The pipeline comprises several stages: structural optimization and EOS fitting, electronic structure, optical properties, thermoelectric transport, and JSON compilation. Managing these interdependent steps and tool invocations (DFT code, post-processing) raises orchestration complexity, though each stage is standard.

difficulty.reasoning: The task reproduces standard DFT properties (lattice constant, band gap, dielectric constant, thermoelectric) of simple alkali halides using well-established codes. The method is a textbook GGA-PBE calculation with a minor alloying variation, so conceptual difficulty is low; execution involves a multi-stage pipeline but with routine steps and tiny systems.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Tiny unit cells (2–16 atoms) require only CPU; pseudopotential libraries are small; memory needs are trivial for modern DFT codes.
